r:
What the renderer writes for these elements depends on the plugins of the Discourse site the posts go to. Open "Site" in the top bar and switch them.
[b]discourse-bbcode[/b] (a plugin that needs an install) keeps colors and sizes. Without it only the text is left. phpBB stores a size as percent, which is what the plugin reads:
[color=#c13d1a]Red text[/color], [color=teal]teal text[/color], [size=150]large text[/size], [size=85]small text[/size], [color=navy][size=120][b]all of it[/b][/size][/color].
[b]spoiler-alert[/b] (bundled with Discourse) blurs a spoiler. Without it the content is written as it is:
The winner is [spoiler]the tortoise[/spoiler]. [spoiler=The ending]Everybody goes home, and [b]nobody[/b] is surprised.[/spoiler]
